description: A country elevator's cash bid for physical grain, from USDA AMS daily cash grain bid reports, searched across every state report at once — which AMS itself cannot do, because MARS is report-centric with no commodity-wide search. Returns basis in CENTS per bushel against a named futures month, price in DOLLARS per bushel, location, grade, elevator class, freight and delivery. THIS IS NOT a futures settlement and NOT the NASS season-average price received that price.latest returns for ZC/ZW/ZS; all three are correct and all three differ. Values are ranges where the report published a range. Latest published print only — there is no stored history, so this cannot tell you whether basis is strengthening; read each row's basis_change, which is the agency's own answer. Wheat must name its class: CBOT soft red winter, KCBT hard red winter and MGE hard red spring traded 35 cents apart on the same page. Paid.

elevator_class.description: Narrow to one kind of buyer.

include_stale.description: Include reports that have not published recently. Excluded and named by default.

month.description: Futures month code ("Z") or contract ("2026-12") the basis is quoted against.

name: cash.bids

bids.description: Cash bid rows, widest basis first

instrument.description: Catalog instrument where one quotes this class; null is a real answer
